dialogs.text: *sob* I did not expect to be locked up in this cage... My dignity as one of the Masters of the Night-Wind is all but gone now, surely!
A disgrace to the tribe, a disgrace indeed...
You again? What happened this time?
Ah, my savior, we meet again... *sigh* I'm sorry you had to see that.
Ah, did I not say previously that my name is Conulaf, a trainee priest of the Masters of the Night-Wind?

As the name suggests, I'm presently in training to become a priest. And... Well, our tribal elders told me that my ancestor, Sanhaj, used to get into betting battles with people from other tribes, often tricking them silly in the process.
And so the elders said, "Go make and win some bets! That's the only way to qualify as a true Master of the Night-Wind!"
So when I passed by and saw a tournament taking place, I... I made a bet too. I mean, who cares if you've got a "defending Tepetlisaurus champion" or a "Qucusaurus, the decade's strongest rookie"...
Our Iktomisaurs would be the strongest, naturally!
That's what I thought, anyway... but I bet on the wrong Saurian.
Not only did I wind up in debt, but I got locked in here to boot...
"Heh, tell you what," they said. "We'll give you ten times your Mora back if the Iktomisaurus emerges the champ. If not, you can just stay in this cage, alright?"
What should I do now? Oh, if only there was an Iktomisaurus who could give those other two Saurians a good thumping...
That way, I could get out of here, and get ten times the Mora too! ... Ah, I mean, most importantly, we can't have those two tribes look down on our wonderful Iktomisaurs!
*sob* Please, dear savior. If you could find such an Iktomisaurus...
*sigh* I probably shouldn't spout such nonsense. You're not of our tribe anyway — where are you supposed to just find an Iktomisaurus like that?
I'll see about finding one...
R—Really, could you? I—In that case, I'm just going to stay in this cage and wait for an update from you...
Come on, Gigadrill! You're the previous champ — no way you'll lose to that soft-looking Qucusaurus!
That's it, Drill, that's it! Bob and weave, and look for an opportunity!

Odds are one to one-point-zero-five. Both sides are quite evenly matched in strength... But I'm hoping Gigadrill takes the win.
Still, you saw how Crimson Dancer warded off Gigadrill's signature drill attack by ducking into its feathers — launched a counterattack right after, too.
The situation's looking dicey for Gigadrill, I'd say...
Hmm? You're a new face. First time watching the contest? No rules here, mind, but if you lose the bet, then your Mora goes to the house, y'hear?
We had a lass from the Masters of the Night-Wind who couldn't pay up after losing a while back. You know where she is now? Bawling inside that cage, that's where.
Both sides are engaging full-force now, but if they keep doing that, it's going to take a huge toll on their endurance...
Hehe... Come on now... When do we get to see those finishing moves...
Come on, Gigadrill! You're the previous champ — no way you'll lose to that soft-looking Qucusaurus!
That's it, Drill, that's it! Bob and weave, and look for an opportunity!
Oh great Sanhaj, please take pity upon your poor descendant... Guide my savior to <color=#00E1FFFF>a mighty Iktomisaurus indeed</color>...
May those from the other tribes who have humiliated your progeny be taught a lesson... *sob*

Good, you're not seriously injured, and there's a sauro-vet clinic nearby... We'll do a complete checkup once we get there.
But I can see that we've still got a long way to go, Gigadrill... Let's do this together.
Wroo...
Heh... Feeling sore about that loss, are ya?
Crooo...
That Iktomisaurus... *sigh* Can hardly believe such a strong one exists. Still, a loss is a loss. We'll just have to win next time!
Grrawk!
The Iktomisaurus makes a sudden, dynamic entrance and defeats the original victor, the "Crimson Dancer."\nAs agreed, the organizer frees the reckless young lady from the Masters of the Night-Wind...
*sob* Ohhh... I thought I was about to be sent home in a cage, my family forced to pay my debts...
And while I was in there, I suddenly remembered that our ancestors would stack the deck first before betting, which is how they'd win...
So, yes, I had much time for self-reflection while in this cage — you know, about my unrealistic expectations of beating others at their own game.
I don't know where you managed to find such a powerful Iktomisaurus...
But I'm grateful all the same! With your help, I've recovered my investment, and even earned back ten times the Mora I put in!
I, on the other hand, barely did anything... But I'll need to find a soft bed to lie down on all the same. My back hurts all over from being stuck in this cage for half a day.
As for the winnings, you keep them, dear savior! The elders said that keeping an unexpected windfall close will only bring one misfortune, so it's best I give it away!
